en: Hey, buddy! Wanna play koi-koi?
Uncle Kaz! See if you can <Color:8>win 1,000 points or more at koi-koi<Color:Default>. You know the hands, right?
(Haruka wants me to <Color:8>win 1,000 points or more at koi-koi<Color:Default>.)
Aww, okay. Some other time.
All right. Maybe next time, then.
Hang on, you need at least 200 points to play koi-koi. Buy them at the front desk, okay?
Excellent. You're in?
That's what I wanted to hear! Right this way!
Is that so? Drop by again, okay?
You can play oicho-kabu here. Want to?
Uncle Kaz! See if you can <Color:8>win 300 points or more at oicho-kabu<Color:Default>. Maybe you can even get a 9-1!
(Haruka wants me to <Color:8>win 300 points or more at oicho-kabu<Color:Default>.)
Oh. Another time, then.
You need at least a hundred points to play oicho-kabu. The front desk sells them.
Sure, I'll play.
Good. Let's start.
No. I'll pass.
Thank you. Now I have five more boxes to sell.
Thank you. Now I have four more boxes to sell.
Wow, you sold two boxes? Thank you! Now I have three more boxes to sell.
Wow, you sold three boxes? Thank you! Now I have two more boxes to sell.
Wow, thank you! Now there's only one more box to sell.
That so? All right, then...
I'll keep helpin' ya sell those matches. We'll get it done.
I'll buy the rest of the matches off ya. That's 500 yen for five boxes, right?
Oh, but...
I'll buy the rest of the matches off ya. That's 400 yen for four boxes, right?
I'll buy the rest of the matches off ya. That's 300 yen for three boxes, right?
I'll buy the rest of the matches off ya. That's 200 yen for two boxes, right?
I'll buy the rest of the matches off ya. That's a hundred yen for one box, right?
Huh? Darn it, I can't. Don't have that much money right now. Sorry I got yer hopes up.
Oh, it's okay. You've already helped me so much.
Hm. Hope so...
Ya deserve it⑬it's a reward for all yer hard work. And that'll be enough to buy a present for your ma, right?
Oh... Are you sure?
Yeah, I was just thinkin' I could use some matches. Can't stand this cold myself...
Oh! Thank you so much!
You handed over <Color:8>500 yen<Color:Default>.
You handed over <Color:8>400 yen<Color:Default>.
You handed over <Color:8>300 yen<Color:Default>.
You handed over <Color:8>200 yen<Color:Default>.
You handed over <Color:8>100 yen<Color:Default>.
Oh, hello!
How's it goin'? Are those matches sellin'?
No, not at all... No one will buy my last five boxes.
Really? Hm...
I'll help ya sell the matches. Just five boxes, right? Couldn't be all that hard.
What? You'd really do that?
Yeah. You wait right here. If ya see someone who might buy, come join me. Sound good?
Help the little match girl peddle her matches. Talk to people on the street and sell off her last five boxes.
Try not to work too hard, little lady. I'm sure ya got what it takes to get it done.
I think so! Thank you!
So, you got enough for your ma's present now?
Yes! You were a big help. I'm going to go buy it right now!
Bet yer ma'll be real happy. What're ya gonna get her?
Um, some hand cream. Mama's hands are always dry and cracked. She says they hurt when it's cold.
Sounds like the perfect gift, then.
But, um... where do they sell it?
I know a store that would have it for sure. Want me to show ya?
Are ya all right?
I'm j-just... c-cold...
(Gotta get some food into her. I'll buy somethin' somewhere.)
Here, eat this. It'll perk ya up.
Thank you...
Mm, that was yummy. Thank you.
Ya welcome. Uh, you're not gonna go right back to sellin' matches, are ya?
I have to. I need to sell five more boxes or I can't buy Mama's present.
Five more boxes... That an easy number to sell?
Um... I don't know. Nobody's bought any since you bought a whole box that one time.
Really? Darn. There's not much demand, I guess.
(Five boxes would only be 500 yen. I could just give her that money, but... she wanted to earn it.)
Is something the matter?
Huh? Oh, nothin'. Just thinkin'...
Oh, hello. Would you like some matches? They're, um, very good for making fire.
A hundred yen a box, right?
(A match seller in this day and age? This a joke?)
I'd be so grateful if you bought some, sir... Please?
How much?
It's one hundred yen a box. But if you only want a few, that would be good, too...
Sorry. Some other time.
Sure. I'll take a box.
Darn. I can't. Don't got even a hundred yen to my name.
Sorry, little lady. I'll come back when I got more cash.
Must be tough doin' this in the cold. Ya tryin' to be the "Little Match Girl," eh? Like in the story?
Yes! I thought maybe I could do it just like her, with the matches we have at home.
Heh, that's cute. A nice way to play pretend.
Oh, I'm not playing pretend. I need money so I can buy a Christmas present for Mama.
Really? Where's yer ma now?
At work. She works during the day, and then at night, too. Because Papa's not with us anymore.
Mm? Your pa's not around?
Papa got sick and died a long time ago. That's why I'm the only one who can buy a present for Mama.
Yeah, I understand. You're a good soul, little lady. By all rights, a kid like you should just be lookin' forward to yer own gifts.
Don't work yerself too hard. Look at ya. Yer shiverin'.
I'm okay. Mama works a lot harder for me every day.
Please buy more matches from me another time. I'll be here every day.
Hey, ya wanna buy some matches?
What is this about? Please, I don't want any trouble.
Hold on, I ain't tryin' to shake ya down. I just wanna sell you some matches.
Please, sir. Buy some matches.
Uh, uh, I'm sorry!
There he goes. What'd he think was goin' on?
Hey mister, it's cold, ain't it? Wanna buy some matches? Could build a nice fire at home with 'em.
Matches? If you're gonna shake people down, couldn't you at least find someone better off than me?
Not tryin' to shake anyone down. It's a reasonable price. Hundred yen for a box. How 'bout it?
Please, sir...!
A hundred yen? You'll let me go for just that?
Nobody's keepin' ya. I just happen to be helpin' this little girl sell matches. Ain't it obvious yet that I mean ya no harm?
No, it's really not obvious at all...
Well I'm tellin' ya, ain't I?
Sorry! I get it! I'd like to buy a box of matches, please!
Yeah? 'Preciate it.
You sold a box of matches.
Need some matches, lady? They're a hundred yen a box.
How dare you! You should be ashamed, trying to extort decent people. I am not buying any of your "matches."
Any way I can change your mind?
C'mon, little lady, you ask her, too.
Um, excuse me, ma'am. Please, would you buy some?
Are you even related to this girl? Or... Did you kidnap her!?
No, no, I'm just helpin' her sell her wares.
Listen, sweetie. Did this man take you from your family? You can tell me, it's okay.
Ma'am, he's just a nice man helping me. It was really hard trying to sell matches by myself.
Hm, guess I was hasty to judge. I'll make up for it by buying a box. Just one, though!
Oh, you will? Thank you very much!
Thanks lady, you're, um... the best. 'Preciate it.
Hey lady, could I get ya to buy some matches at a hundred yen a box?
What are you suggesting? Please, don't!
Don't make a ruckus. I ain't suggestin' ya shake out yer purse or nothin'.
Please buy some! Pretty please?
Leave me alone! I'll scream for help!
Hey, honey-pie, what's the commotion? This guy giving you a hard time?
Yes! He's asking me to... well, to buy matches!
Buy matches? What's that mean? Probably some fucked up shit or something.
No, and watch yer language. It's just regular matches. On behalf of this li'l girl. You fellas wanna buy some?
Haha! Get lost, you stupid shit! And take your bitch daughter with you!
My bad! My bad! I'll buy some matches!
Oh yeah? You're too kind.
Don't know how I forgot how much I needed some!
Ugh... Where the hell did you learn to fight like that!?
I'm just a little match man, with a little match girl. Hundred yen a box. You want one, dontcha?
Fine, if it'll get ya to fuck off!
Heh. Much obliged.
Um, thank you...?
Hey, how 'bout some matches? Hundred yen a box.
You oughta realize who you're talking to, old man! The yakuza don't have time for your bullshit!
Eep!
No need to go yellin' like that. You're scarin' her.
Fuck you say!?
Calm down. Do ya wanna buy some matches, or not?
Do <Italic>you</Italic> wanna buy a death wish!? Huh!?
Say, lady, ya need some matches? Hundred yen a box.
Pardon me?
Please buy a box...
Why did you ask me, out of all these people?
'Cause ya look like a nice person. That ain't a bad thing, right?
Really? That's how you saw me?
Is there somethin' wrong?
No, I'm just surprised. I just got dumped by my boyfriend, and... And he said it's because I'm so selfish. Here I am, right before Christmas... single again...
That's a shame. Tell ya somethin', though. Ya don't look selfish at all to me.
...Thanks. My confidence took such a beating, I need all the compliments I can get. Anyway, yes, I will take a box.
Yaaay! Thank you!
No, thank you. And good luck.
'Cause ya looked cold, and these things could warm ya up.
I look... cold, now? *sniffle*
Why're ya cryin'?
My boyfriend called me an ice queen and then dumped me! I guess everyone in the world thinks I'm c-c-cold! *sob*
Whoa! Come on now, don't go bawlin' like that. People are lookin' at us; they'll think I said somethin' to ya.
Geez, you men are all alike! You only care about yourselves!
Coulda been anyone, honestly...
Could have been anyone...? Hmph. That's what he said, too.
He?
My boyfriend... I mean, my ex-boyfriend! He only wanted me for my body!
Okay, calm down...
And after doing it in every position he wanted, but not any that I wanted! He said he's sick of my selfishness!? The nerve of that guy!
Men are the worst! What do they think I am, a slab of meat!?
Hey, there's a kid right here.
Don't talk to me! I hate dating! I hate everyone!
That didn't go well. Gotta watch what I say.
Hey, buddy. Wanna buy some matches?
Did you say matches? What a coincidence! I was just thinking I needed to stop and get some on my way home.
Really? Well, these are a hundred yen a box.
I most certainly will take one, then. So convenient!
Thanks for buyin'. Ya really needed 'em, eh?
For my pipe! Anyone who smokes pipes knows what a pain it is to light them with a lighter.
And I ran out of matches, but lo and behold! You showed up!
Glad we found ya.
Me too! Thank you kindly!
Matches? What's that? The latest thing on the street?
Huh? What're ya sayin'?
Matches, you said. Is it good shit? I've been looking to get real fucked up, man.
No, it's nothin' like that. I'm talkin' about real matches, the little sticks that catch fire when ya scrape 'em. Wanna buy a box for a hundred yen?
Okay... I get it. If you wanna know more about the goods, you gotta buy a sample, is that it?
Ain't got a clue what you're sayin'.
Yeah man, I gotcha. I'll give it a go. Gimme a box.
Yeah? 'Preciate your business.
Oh, thank you very much!
Suzuki-san, that was somethin' else! It was like watchin' the god of noodles at work!
Really can't thank ya enough for today. Here, this is your pay.
You got <Color:8>8,000 yen<Color:Default>.
Come on by any time ya want, okay? I'd be happy to have ya work the counter again if ya ever feel like it, Suzuki-san.
Tell your boss I said hi, too. See ya!
That wasn't half bad, Suzuki-san!
Thanks for the help today. Here's your pay.
You got <Color:8>4,000 yen<Color:Default>.
Come by and help out again if ya got the time. I reckon you'll do even better!
Tell that boss of yours I said hi, too. See ya!
Suzuki-san... I was watchin' ya work, and I gotta say... You handled those noodles like a rookie.
Still, it's enough ya came by and offered to help. Here's your pay.
You got <Color:8>3,000 yen<Color:Default>.
You got <Color:8>2,000 yen<Color:Default>.
Still, I'm glad you were here to work the counter, even if ya were fumblin' up a bit. Come by and help out again if ya got the time.
Give my regards to the chief, okay? See ya!
Are ya not feelin' well or something, Suzuki-san? Come help out when ya feel better.
Thank you. Now is your back okay?
Huh? My back? Oh... Oh, hey!
Watchin' you work your magic made me forget all about it. I feel fine now! Hahaha!
That's... good.
You were a huge help today. Here's your pay.
Oh, and say hi to the chief for me, will ya? Thanks again!
That wasn't half bad for your first time, Suzuki-san! Color me surprised!
